internal_review.result: No unresolved proof gap identified; this is internal AI-assisted review.

scope.exceptional_witnesses: Sections 2-4 and Appendices A-C: polynomial regularity, subgroup invariance, purity, row degrees, factorial denominators, Wilson congruence, Klein identities, Cartier pullback and nonzero binary coefficients.
scope.radial_witness: Section 5: independently derived all-order binomial cancellation of pure moments, positive double-integral formula and triangle evaluation for marked moments, normalizer invariance and explicit radius scaling. The new printed formulas were reread against that derivation.
scope.connected_classification: Section 6: compact forms including disconnected stabilizers, line/doublet construction, regular dual matrix coefficients, branching rules, proper SL2 stabilizer images and subdirect products.
scope.disconnected_classification_and_nullcone: Section 7: number-field specialization, completely splitting primes, exponent separation, Newton identities, component averaging and the character-lattice criterion. Finite spaces, inversion and factor-permutation examples were also checked.
scope.recompositions: Section 8: CRT choice of a fixed marker, valuation extension with unit coefficients, unique negative valuation, descent of algebraicity, finite-generation Eisenstein argument and prime-quotient reduction for coefficient algebras.
scope.primary_source_dependencies: All 13 current bibliography entries checked against original passages; locators and applicability are recorded below.

internal_review.executor: Internal Codex/ChatGPT proof and source audits, including a fresh-reader reconstruction; no human or external review claimed.

resolved_exposition_findings: Give the full classification strategy, a Laurent-monomial example and a worked first radial moment.
Distinguish the extension beyond Long's spherical theorem and define K-finiteness and defining doublets.
Replace the radial partial-fraction calculation with a positive double integral, and prove radial purity independently by phase cancellation.
Use explicit unit-radius coordinates in the scaling argument; identify the doublet by a unitary equivariant isomorphism.
Supply algebraic affineness and connected Hilbert-Mumford references with precise scope; pin the corrected Cartier reference.
Define Gamma, the rational denominator, the extended functional h_R and eventual purity before use.
Retain the explicit closed-subgroup hypothesis, half-integral branching boundary checks, compact-form citation and coefficient-field reduction.
Describe the actual AI assistance and internal review scope; keep operational instructions outside the article.
